business_problem: Riverty needed to fix fragmented CRM activities and poor transparency that were slowing sales execution and limiting the value it got from its CRM platform.
solution_summary: Capgemini Invent worked with Riverty over a nine-week program to embed Microsoft Copilot for Sales into the company's Dynamics 365 CRM estate and turn an underused sales platform into an AI-assisted workflow. The engagement started with a business-alignment phase that mapped Copilot use cases to Riverty's sales goals and defined a technology roadmap for future AI-driven CRM improvements. The team then upgraded Riverty to Microsoft Dynamics Sales Premium, onboarded users technically, and delivered hands-on enablement so sellers could use meeting preparation, email summarization, faster record lookup, and CRM data maintenance inside their daily process. By combining platform changes, training, and adoption management, the project turned generative AI into an operational layer for CRM rather than a side experiment.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Sales
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI assistant for meeting preparation, email summarization, and guided sales work inside Riverty's CRM process.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
solution_components.role: Acts as the core customer relationship management platform that stores sales data and operating workflows.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Dynamics Sales Premium
solution_components.role: Extends the CRM environment with advanced AI capabilities that support Riverty's broader Copilot-enabled sales roadmap.

data_flow: Sales and account data remain in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, where Microsoft Copilot for Sales uses customer context to summarize emails, prepare meetings, retrieve sales information, and help users maintain CRM records. The Sales Premium upgrade expands those AI capabilities, and user training ensures the improved data and workflows feed back into Riverty's sales operation consistently.
business_outcome: Riverty improved CRM satisfaction, speed of information retrieval, and day-to-day system usage while creating a stronger foundation for future AI-enabled sales and partner-management use cases.
